title: Asam Sahitya Sabha Barsiki - Dibrugarh Sammilan (34th Session)
author: Hariprasad Neog (General Secretary, Asam Sahitya Sabha)
genre: Historical Proceedings, Linguistic Surveys & Upper Assam Tribal Studies
description: Historical proceedings and commemorative volume of the 34th annual session of Asam Sahitya Sabha held at Dibrugarh in December 1966 - January 1967. It features scholarly addresses on Tai Khamyang, Tai Phake, Tai Khamti, and Ahom linguistic survival in Upper Assam, tribal folklore, historical chronicles, and dialectology.
